title: Add validation gate for untrusted workspace path arguments
description: Safety signal detected: two observations show unsanitized workspace path arguments in plan execution requests. If exploited, this could allow path traversal to sensitive directories outside the workspace root. Proposal is to add a validation gate in the execution pipeline that rejects paths with '..' traversal, symlinks to outside the workspace, or other injection patterns. This is a critical safety improvement that should be prioritized.

evidence.evidenceSummary: Two independent observations confirmed unsanitized paths in execution requests. One matching memory record documents the path traversal vulnerability pattern.

factors: Path traversal could expose sensitive files
Vulnerability is actively being observed in execution requests
mitigation: Immediate: add validation gate before execution
Short-term: audit all recent execution requests for exploitation attempts
Long-term: add static analysis to detect unsafe path patterns
risk.impactDescription: Unsanitized path arguments in plan execution requests could allow path traversal attacks to access sensitive files outside the workspace root.
